data.title: Exelon Crews Mobilize to Support Customers and Restore Power During and After Severe Thanksgiving Storm
data.description:
Exelon and its operating companies mobilized employees, contractors and mutual-assistance resources during Thanksgiving as a powerful nor’easter brought damaging winds, heavy rain and coastal flooding to parts of the Mid-Atlantic, causing widespread damage and power outages.

The storm swept across the Mid-Atlantic, leaving hundreds of thousands of customers without service across BGE, PECO, Atlantic City Electric, Delmarva Power and Pepco territories. As of early Friday afternoon, the vast majority of those outages had been restored quickly and safely. Exelon continues to direct additional resources to the areas with the most severe damage to restore power to customers still without service.

"Our customers count on us every day, and that responsibility takes on a special meaning during the holidays, when families are gathering and communities are depending on us," said Mike Innocenzo, Exelon’s Chief Operating Officer. "Thousands of Exelon employees, contractors and partners have answered the call this holiday to safely restore power in the communities where they live and work. I want to thank them for being there for our customers and their neighbors when it matters most, and for staying on until the work is done."

Working around the clock for customers and their families

Across the Mid-Atlantic, crews from BGE, PECO, Atlantic City Electric, Delmarva Power and Pepco continue to work around the clock to restore power quickly and safely in some of the storm’s harshest conditions. Coastal wind gusts reached speeds as high as 70 mph in parts of New Jersey, Delaware and Maryland, while several inches of rain and flooding brought down trees, limbs, poles and wires and closed roads, limiting safe access to some of the hardest-hit areas. Exelon is moving resources to where they are needed most, including ComEd mutual assistance personnel and resources from the Chicagoland area that have traveled east to reinforce the hardest-hit communities.

Always on, with safety first

Throughout our service territories, dedicated employees work around the clock, preparing before storms, responding when conditions are at their worst and staying on the job until every customer is restored. Safety remains our top priority. Exelon and its utilities urge customers to stay away from downed wires and always assume they are energized. Customers should report outages and check their local utility's website or mobile app for the latest restoration information.

About Exelon

Exelon () is a Fortune 200 company and one of the nation’s largest utility companies, serving almost 11 million customers through six fully regulated transmission and distribution utilities — Atlantic City Electric, BGE, ComEd, Delmarva Power, PECO, and Pepco. Exelon’s more than 20,000 employees dedicate their time and expertise to supporting our communities through reliable, affordable and efficient energy delivery, workforce development, equity, economic development and volunteerism. Follow @Exelon on X and LinkedIn.

data.title: S&P 500, Nasdaq End Best Week In Over A Year As AI Optimism Makes Comeback — VZ, ANT, ADBE, TSLA In Focus
data.description:
Key points:
  • The S&P 500 gained about 5.6%, the Nasdaq 100 jumped 6.6%, and the Dow Jones index gained 5.5% in the week ending November 27.
  • Verizon Communications is in talks to buy the broadband operator Fidium in a $6 billion deal.
  • OpenAI reportedly countersued Apple on Friday.

U.S. stock indices rose on Friday and posted their best weekly gains in several months amid a revival of optimism around the AI trade.

The S&P 500 gained about 5.6%, the Nasdaq 100 jumped 6.6%, and the Dow Jones index gained 5.5% in the week ending November 27. All stock indices also ended Friday higher, with the trading day cut short for Thanksgiving.

The SPDR S&P 500 ETF (SPY) gained about 5.8%, and the SPDR Dow Jones Industrial Average ETF (DIA) rose 5.9%. Meanwhile, the Nasdaq-100 tracking Invesco QQQ Trust (QQQ) added 6.6% this week.

Meanwhile, the VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH) and the iShares Semiconductor ETF gained between 8% and 10% this week, with Nvidia (NVDA) supporting gains. Nvidia was the third-best performer on the Nasdaq 100 for this week, with weekly gains of about 19.6%.

Retail sentiment on Stocktwits improved to the ‘extremely bullish’ territory from ‘neutral’ for the SPDR S&P 500 ETF (SPY); it remained ‘extremely bullish’ on the Invesco QQQ (QQQ) and ‘bearish’ on the SPDR Dow Jones ETF (DIA).

US Market Drivers

IndexWeekly MoveClose
Dow Jones Industrial Average5.5%50,781.33
S&P 5005.6%7,296.88
Nasdaq 1006.6%26,689.20

While investor sentiment around AI seemed to have improved this week, as seen in the strong gains in the Nasdaq and coinciding ETFs, risks around rising borrowing costs and the longevity of the AI trade remain in doubt.

“Until the market can get a clear sense of what’s next, we should expect continued volatility,” said Tom Essaye of The Sevens Report.

Meanwhile, Anthropic PBC (ANT) share price pushed past its $83 initial public offering price on Friday, ending its first full week of trading higher.

The stock gained about 11% from its IPO price in the holiday-shortened week ending November 27. On Friday, the stock also hit its highest intraday price since Monday, snapping a two-day run of finishes below the IPO level as wider market risk appetite improved across tech stocks after the nearly month-long Nvidia (NVDA)-led selloff.

Key Trending Stocks

According to a Financial Times report, Verizon Communications (VZ) is negotiating the acquisition of broadband provider Fidium for $6 billion, a strategic transaction aimed at broadening its network coverage and capturing a larger portion of the nationwide internet customer base.

Shares of EV giant Tesla (TSLA) rose on Friday, adding to a strong weekly performance, as the company reportedly plans to acquire Germany-based machine-tool maker EMAG.

OpenAI has countersued Apple with a California lawsuit accusing the iPhone maker of stealing trade secrets and squeezing hardware suppliers to block rival devices, the FT reported on Friday.

Palantir Technologies (PLTR) secured a defense contract reportedly worth around $300 million from Poland on Friday, amid an increasing use of AI in critical defense and military operations.

U.S. shoppers are increasingly leaning on AI tools to compare models, evaluate specifications, and weigh alternatives before visiting a retailer's website or store, according to Adobe's 2026 holiday shopping data.

data.title: South America eyes $18 billion gas, power integration plan, study says
data.description:
A study backed by regional development bank CAF and the Latin American Energy Organization (OLACDE) on Friday identified 17 infrastructure projects worth $18 billion that would create an integrated natural gas and electricity market across six South American countries.

The plan, covering Mercosur trade bloc members Argentina, Brazil, Paraguay, and Uruguay, as well as Bolivia and Chile, aims to unlock up to $4.5 billion in net economic benefits for the region and create more than 200,000 jobs by 2035, according to findings presented in Montevideo.

  • Gas interconnections carried 22 million cubic meters daily in 2025, 29% of their capacity

  • The study evaluated 11 integration routes, 7 of which depend on Argentina's Manuel Belgrano pipeline to move gas from the country's Vaca Muerta shale formation

  • The route to central Chile offered the highest cost savings relative to required investment compared with importing liquefied natural gas (LNG), the study found

  • The Argentina-Brazil pipeline corridor via Bolivia offers the largest potential impact, the study added, though its competitiveness hinges on Argentine export duties, Bolivian transit fees, and Brazilian transport tariffs

  • Under a limited-budget scenario, upgrading Argentina's Northern Gas Pipeline would require $2.4 billion in additional investment to yield $4.3 billion in net regional benefits

  • The study recommended advancing via pipelines, so countries can sign long-term stable contracts while negotiating a regional framework treaty

data.title: Phaos Technology Explores AI-Enabled Automated Car Wash Opportunity in Southeast Asia
data.description:
SINGAPORE, Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Phaos Technology Holdings (Cayman) Limited (NYSE American: POAS) ("Phaos" or the "Company") today outlined an opportunity to develop automated car wash and vehicle care services in Southeast Asia, particularly in Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia and Thailand. The Company is evaluating Singapore and Malaysia as initial markets for services that combine convenience for drivers and fleet operators with automation and water reuse. In a second phase, it may consider expanding into other Southeast Asian markets.

Singapore had more than 650,000 cars in October 2026, including nearly 99,000 private-hire cars, according to Land Transport Authority data1. In Malaysia, the Malaysian Automotive Association2 reported 630,461 new passenger vehicles sold from January through October 2026, up about 4% year over year. Separately, Grand View Research3 estimates that Malaysia's broader car wash services market could grow from US$208.9 million in 2025 to US$361.7 million by 2033, a projected annual growth rate of 7.3% from 2026 to 2033. The forecast covers multiple wash formats and does not estimate revenue for Phaos.

In Indonesia, Ken Research4 estimates that paid professional car wash services could grow from US$390 million in 2025 to US$686 million in 2032, or 8.4% annually. In Thailand, a nationwide National Statistical Office survey5 put 2023 receipts for businesses classified under car washing, polishing and similar services at THB 14.1 billion. In October 2026, Bangchak6 reported Lodon JetX automated washes at 50 of its fuel stations, showing adoption of the format. The two market figures cover broader service categories and do not measure Phaos's addressable revenue.

Phaos is exploring the use of artificial intelligence (AI) to automate car washing, with the aim of reducing labor costs and improving water recycling. In Singapore, Inchcape reported that the automated gantry it developed with Kärcher can recycle up to 85% of the water used per wash.7

"We see an opportunity to serve vehicles that need regular care," said Gan Hong Loon, Chief Executive Officer of Phaos. "Singapore and specific regions in Malaysia give us places to test demand and site economics before we consider expanding."

About Phaos Technology Holdings (Cayman) Limited

Headquartered in Singapore, Phaos has its roots in advanced microscopy and is pursuing a strategic repositioning toward engineering, procurement and construction (EPC). For more information, visit the company website.8

Forward-Looking Statements

This release contains forward-looking statements under applicable U.S. securities laws, including the Private Securities Litigation Reform Act of 1995, where applicable. These statements concern potential services and sites and possible expansion. Actual outcomes may differ materially due to financing, required approvals, site economics, customer adoption and other risks described in the Company's Annual Report on Form 20-F, as amended, and subsequent filings with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. These statements speak only as of this release date. Phaos undertakes no duty to update them except as required by law.

No Offer or Solicitation

This release is for information only. It does not constitute an offer to sell or a solicitation of an offer to purchase any securities.

data.title: Mountain Province Diamonds Announces Third Quarter Financial Results for 2026
data.description:
TORONTO, Nov. 27, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Mountain Province Diamonds Inc. ("Mountain Province", the "Company") today announces financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026 ("the Quarter" or "Q3 2026") from the Gahcho Kué Diamond Mine ("GK Mine"). All figures are expressed in Canadian Dollars unless otherwise noted.

Q3 2026 Key Takeaways

  • 913,255 carats were sold for total proceeds of $49.8 million (US$35.7 million) at an average price of $55 per carat (US$39).
  • Adjusted EBITDA1 of ($4.1) million.
  • Loss from mine operations of $38.4 million.
  • Net loss of $371.7 million or $1.75 basic and diluted loss per share.

1Cash costs of production, including capitalized stripping costs, and adjusted EBITDA are non-IFRS measures with no standardized meaning prescribed under IFRS.  See "Reconciliation of non-IFRS measures" at the end of the news release for explanation and reconciliation.

Jonathan Comerford, Chairman of Mountain Province Diamonds, commented:

"Although the GK Mine recovered 2,088,104 carats at an average grade of 2.30 carats per tonne in the third quarter of 2026, the record production performance occurred against a backdrop of continued weakness in the diamond market. The average realised selling price of US$39 per carat and the Company's financial results reflect these challenging market conditions.

Subsequent to the quarter end, De Beers Canada Inc. ("De Beers") obtained the Company's 49% participating interest in Gahcho Kué under the restructuring agreement announced on 1 October 2026. In return, the Company was released from all indebtedness owing and related obligations to De Beers arising from the joint venture, including the remaining reclamation payments. Following an extensive review, the Board believed the agreement represented the most appropriate course of action available to the Company in the circumstances.

The restructuring agreement also preserves a potential route back to ownership. It provides Mountain Province with an option, exercisable prior to 31 December 2029, to repurchase the 49% participating interest in the GK Mine for a price equivalent to the associated share of decommissioning costs. It also provides rights of first offer and first refusal should De Beers elect to sell all or substantially all of the GK Mine or its mineral rights following completion. The ability of the Company to realise value from these rights will depend on future market conditions and the availability of appropriate funding.

The Noteholders and Dunebridge have agreed to a six-month suspension of interest and capital repayments and the exercise of specified rights, providing Mountain Province with time to pursue a restructuring of its remaining debt and explore potential sources of funding. The diamond market remains challenging and the Company's ability to pursue future opportunities will depend on market conditions and access to capital. These opportunities include the retained rights relating to the GK Mine and the future development potential of the Kennady diamond assets. Our immediate focus is on managing the Company's financial position and preserving as much future optionality and value for shareholders as possible.

Financial Highlights for Q3 2026

  • Revenue from 913,255 carats sold at $49.8 million (US$35.7 million) at an average realised value of $55 per carat (US$39) compared to $29.2 million from 409,081 carats sold in for the third quarter ended September 30, 2025 ("Q3 2025") $29.2m (US$21.2 million) at an average realized value of $71 per carat (US$52).
  • Adjusted EBITDA1 of ($4.1) million compared to ($29.0) million in Q3 2025.
  • Loss from mine operations of $38.4 million compared to $3.7 million in Q3 2025.
  • Cash costs of production, including capitalized stripping costs1 of $108 per tonne treated (2024: $143 per tonne) and $47 per carat recovered (2025: $121 per carat).
  • Net loss of $371.7 million or $1.75 loss per share (2025: Net loss of $55.9 million or $0.26 loss per share). Included in the determination of net loss are the derecognition and impairment charge of $314,883 and foreign exchange losses of $1.6 million, the majority of which is an unrealized loss arising on the translation of the Company's US Dollar denominated long term debt, because of the weakening of the Canadian Dollar versus US Dollar.

1Cash costs of production, including capitalized stripping costs, and Adjusted EBITDA are non-IFRS measures with no standardized meaning prescribed under IFRS. See the Non-IFRS Measures section of the Company's September 30, 2026 MD&A for explanation and reconciliation.

Operational Highlights for Q3 2026 (all figures reported on a 100% basis unless otherwise stated)

  • 906,759 ore tonnes treated, 7% higher than Q3 2025 (847,024 tonnes treated)
  • 2,088,104 carats recovered, 109% higher than Q3 2025 (1,000,887 carats recovered)
  • Average grade of 2.30 carats per tonne treated, 95% higher than Q3 2025 (1.18 carats per tonne)
  • 1,240,216 ore tonnes mined, 54% higher than Q3 2025 (807,458 ore tonnes mined)

Sales Highlights for Q3 2026

As previously released, during Q3 2026, 913,255 carats were sold for total proceeds of $49.8 million (US$35.7 million), resulting in an average price of $55 per carat (US$39 per carat). These results compare to Q3 2025 where 409,081 carats were sold for total proceeds of $29.2 million (US$21.2 million) at an average price per carat of $71 per carat (US$52 per carat).

Financial Highlights for the nine months ended September 30, 2026

  • Total sales revenue of $133.2 million (US$96.1 million) at an average realised value of $50 per carat (US$36) compared to $110 million in 2025 (US$78.5 million) at an average realized value of $88 per carat (US$63).
  • Adjusted EBITDA2 of $3.7 million (2025: ($0.4) million).
  • Loss from mine operations of $164.4 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, compared to loss from mine operations of $103.9 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2025
  • Cash costs of production, including capitalized stripping costs2, of $117 per tonne treated (2025: $156 per tonne) and $49 per carat recovered (2025: $168 per carat).
  • Net loss of $557.4 million or $2.62 basic and diluted loss per share (for the nine months ended September 30, 2025: net loss $128 million or $0.60 basic and diluted loss per share). Included in the determination of the net loss for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, are the derecognition and impairment charge of $315,905 and foreign exchange losses of $19.6 million, the majority of which is an unrealized losses on the translation of the Company's US Dollar denominated long term debt arising because of the weakening of the Canadian Dollar versus US Dollar.

2Cash costs of production, including capitalized stripping costs, and Adjusted EBITDA are non-IFRS measures with no standardized meaning prescribed under IFRS. See the Non-IFRS Measures section of the Company's September 30, 2026 MD&A for explanation and reconciliation.

Operational Highlights for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 (all figures reported on a 100% basis unless otherwise stated)

  • 12,685,000 total tonnes mined in the nine months ended September 30, 2026, 58% lower than 30,460,000 total tonnes mined for the nine months ended September 30, 2025.
  • 2,557,000 tonnes of ore treated in the nine months ended September 30, 2026, 4% lower than 2,657,000 tonnes treated for the nine months ended September 30, 2025.
  • 6,109,000 carats recovered at an average grade of 2.39 carats per tonne in the nine months ended September 30, 2026, 147% higher than 2,472,000 carats, (0.93 carats per tonne) recovered for the nine months ended September 30, 2025.

The Gahcho Kué Joint Venture property consists of several kimberlites that are actively being mined, developed, and explored for future development. The Company also controls more than 113,000 hectares of highly prospective mineral claims and leases surrounding the Gahcho Kué Mine that include an Indicated mineral resource for the Kelvin kimberlite and Inferred mineral resources for the Faraday kimberlites. Kelvin is estimated to contain 13.62 million carats (Mct) in 8.50 million tonnes (Mt) at a grade of 1.60 carats/tonne and value of US$63/carat, at February 2019. Faraday 2 is estimated to contain 5.45Mct in 2.07Mt at a grade of 2.63 carats/tonne and value of US$140/ct, at February 2019. Faraday 1-3 is estimated to contain 1.90Mct in 1.87Mt at a grade of 1.04 carats/tonne and value of US$75/carat, at February 2019. All resource estimations are based on a 1mm diamond size bottom cut-off.

data.title: IP Strategy Receives Nasdaq Notification Regarding Delayed Form 10-Q Filing
data.description:
GIG HARBOR, WA / ACCESS Newswire / November 27, 2026 / IP Strategy Holdings, Inc. (the "Company" or "IP Strategy") today announced that it received a notification letter from The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC ("Nasdaq") dated November 24, 2026, advising the Company that, because it has not yet filed its Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q for the period ended September 30, 2026 (the "Form 10-Q"), the Company is not currently in compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5250(c)(1).

Nasdaq Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) requires listed companies to timely file all required periodic financial reports with the Securities and Exchange Commission.

The Nasdaq notification has no immediate effect on the listing of the Company's common stock on Nasdaq. However, if the Company fails to timely regain compliance with the Listing Rule 5250(c)(1), the Company's common stock will be subject to delisting from Nasdaq.

Under the Nasdaq Listing Rules, the Company has 60 calendar days from the date of the notification, or until January 23, 2027, to submit to Nasdaq a plan to regain compliance. If Nasdaq accepts the Company's plan, Nasdaq may grant the Company an exception of up to 180 calendar days from the original due date of the Form 10-Q, or until May 24, 2027, to regain compliance. If Nasdaq does not accept the Company's plan, then the Company will have the opportunity to appeal that decision to a Nasdaq Hearings Panel.

The Company is diligently working to complete and file the Form 10-Q and intends to take the necessary steps to regain compliance with Nasdaq's continued listing requirements in December 2026.

About IP Strategy

IP Strategy Holdings, Inc. is the first Nasdaq-listed company to hold $DATA tokens, formerly $IP, as a primary treasury reserve asset and operate validator infrastructure for the DATA Network. The Company provides public market investors broad exposure to the AI-native data economy through a regulated equity vehicle. IP Strategy's treasury reserve enables direct participation in the DATA ecosystem, which supports the sourcing, verification, provenance and auditability of real-world data while enabling trusted attribution and commercialization of digital assets and AI training data.

  • Reported cash and short-term investments of approximately $1.2 million and working capital of approximately $1.6 million as at September 30, 2026

Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - November 27, 2026) - ICG Silver & Gold Ltd. (FSE: JI0) (OTCID: ICGSF) ("ICG" or the "Company") a precious metals exploration Company focused on the Tuscarora District in Elko County, Nevada (the "Project" or "District"), is pleased to announce the filing of its unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements and management's discussion and analysis ("MD&A") for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026. The Company's financial statements, MD&A and related filings are available under the Company's profile on SEDAR+ at www.sedarplus.ca.

Q3 2026 Highlights & Subsequent Events

  • Completed previously announced Phase 1 Drill Program at the Tuscarora District during the quarter. Exploration and evaluation expenditures for the three months ended September 30, 2026 were approximately $1.55 million, of which approximately $1.22 million were related to drilling.
  • Reported cash and short-term investments of approximately $1.19 million and working capital of approximately $1.56 million as at September 30, 2026.
  • Subsequent to quarter end on October 6, 2026, the Company highlighted the new high-grade Battle Mountain Gold Zone in an updated 3D model.

Q3 2026 Commentary

During Q3 2026, the Company successfully completed its previously announced Phase 1 Drill Program at the Tuscarora District, which commenced in June 2026. As reported on September 30, 2026, all six holes between the Silica and Battle Mountain targets encountered gold and/or silver mineralization. Of note, T26RC-04 (Battle Mountain target) intersected 24.3 meters of 10.14 grams per tonne ("g/t") gold ("Au") and 3.4 g/t silver ("Ag") from 181.4 meters down hole. Six additional completed drill holes from King's Vein and East Pediment have assays pending.

For the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, the Company reported a net loss of approximately $2.66 million and $5.39 million, respectively. The primary drivers of expenses during the three and nine months were:

  • Exploration and evaluation expenditures of approximately $1.55 million and $2.16 million, respectively. The Company has completed its previously announced Phase 1 Drill Program, with drilling costs of approximately $1.22 million and geological costs of approximately $0.29 million incurred in Q3 2026. The nine-month period also includes land management costs of approximately $0.32 million, consisting of lease, advance royalty and other payments.
  • Since achieving a public listing on March 31, 2026, expenses associated with operating as a public company including investor relations, professional fees and management compensation costs are included in general and administration expenses (G&A). G&A expenses also include approximately $0.37 million and $1.40 million share-based compensation awards.

ICG Silver & Gold Ltd. is a new mineral exploration and development company advancing the Tuscarora District in northern Nevada. The Company's strategy is centered on:

The Tuscarora District is a silver-gold epithermal system located on the Carlin Trend, approximately one hour northwest of Elko, Nevada. data.title: Annovis Bio Receives NYSE Notice Regarding Continued Listing Standard
data.description:
MALVERN, Pa., Nov. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Annovis Bio, Inc. (“Annovis” or the “Company”), a Phase 3 clinical-stage biotechnology company developing buntanetap, an investigational once-daily pill for neurodegenerative diseases such as Alzheimer’s disease (AD) and Parkinson’s disease (PD), today announced that on November 25, 2026, it received written notice from the New York Stock Exchange (the "NYSE"). The notice states that the Company is not in compliance with Section 802.01C of the NYSE Listed Company Manual. That section requires the average closing price of a listed company's common stock to be at least $1.00 per share over a consecutive 30 trading-day period. As of November 24, 2026, the 30 trading-day average closing price of the Company's common stock was $0.93.

The Company has six months after receiving the notice to regain compliance with the minimum share price requirement. During that time, the Company's common stock will continue to be listed and traded on the NYSE under the symbol "ANVS," with a ".BC" indicator showing that the Company is below the NYSE's continued listing standards. The Company will regain compliance if on the last trading day of any calendar month during the cure period its closing share price is at least $1.00 and its average closing share price over the 30 trading days ending that day is also at least $1.00.

The Company intends to notify the NYSE within the required 10 business days of its intent to cure the deficiency. The Company intends to monitor the closing price of its common stock and to consider all available options to regain compliance, which may include a reverse stock split, subject to stockholder approval.

As previously disclosed, on October 29, 2026, the Company received a separate notice from the NYSE because its average global market capitalization over a consecutive 30 trading-day period was below $50 million and, at the same time, its stockholders' equity was below $50 million. The Company remains subject to the conditions in that notice. The cure periods under the two standards run independently of each other.

The NYSE notice does not immediately affect the listing or trading of the Company's common stock. The notice also does not affect the Company's business operations or its reporting obligations with the Securities and Exchange Commission, and it does not conflict with or cause an event of default under any of the Company's material debt or other agreements.

About Annovis

Headquartered in Malvern, Pennsylvania, Annovis Bio, Inc. is a Phase 3 clinical-stage biotechnology company developing treatments for neurodegenerative diseases such as Alzheimer's disease (AD) and Parkinson's disease (PD). The Company's lead drug candidate, buntanetap (formerly posiphen), is an investigational once-daily oral therapy that inhibits the translation of multiple neurotoxic proteins, including APP and amyloid beta, tau, alpha-synuclein, and TDP-43, through a specific RNA-targeting mechanism of action. By addressing the underlying causes of neurodegeneration, Annovis aims to halt disease progression and improve cognitive and motor functions in patients. For more information, visit www.annovisbio.com and follow us on LinkedIn, YouTube, and X.

Investor Alerts

Interested investors and shareholders are encouraged to sign up for press releases and industry updates by registering for email alerts at https://www.annovisbio.com/email-alerts.

These include statements about the Company's intent and ability to regain compliance with the NYSE's continued listing standards, the potential actions it may take to do so, and the continued listing of its common stock on the NYSE. These statements are based on current expectations and are subject to risks and uncertainties that could cause actual results to differ materially. Those risks include the Company's ability to regain and maintain compliance with NYSE continued listing standards within the applicable cure periods; the NYSE's discretion to begin suspension and delisting procedures, including accelerated delisting if the Company's common stock trades at "abnormally low" levels; market conditions; and the other risks described in the Company's filings with the SEC, including its most recent Annual Report on Form 10-K and later Quarterly Reports on Form 10-Q. data.title: Tom Lee Says Market Tests Traders Vs. Investors: Now Is the Best Time In 18 Months To Buy Stocks
data.description:
Key points:
  • Lee acknowledged that “markets are nervous about the near term,” but argued the longer-term setup remains favorable.
  • He pointed to the current moment as potentially “the best entry point in the last 18 months to own stocks to expect double-digit gains.”
  • Headlines involving “a political football around AI and finger-pointing around China and whether someone should be leading a company,” he said, are “scary, and it’s painful to sit through. But this is all noise in the picture of the next 12 months.”

Fundstrat’s Tom Lee said on Friday that the immediate period in the market is a test of whether people want to be traders or investors, noting that there are “plenty of reasons to be optimistic long term.”

“If they’re investors, there’s plenty of reasons to be optimistic long term,” he said in an appearance on CNBC. “Valuations are there. We know that the U.S. has a huge lead on AI, and AI is incredible.” Looking out three, six, or 12 months, he added that “the risk-reward is incredible for stocks.”

Lee acknowledged that “markets are nervous about the near term,” but argued the longer-term setup remains favorable. He pointed to the current moment as potentially “the best entry point in the last 18 months to own stocks to expect double-digit gains.” He characterized the present weakness as markets “compressing all of these cumulative fears into the final weeks this year.”

Lee Dismisses Nvidia-Caused Volatility

Headlines involving “a political football around AI and finger-pointing around China and whether someone should be leading a company,” he said, are “scary, and it’s painful to sit through. But this is all noise in the picture of the next 12 months.”

Lee was referring to Nvidia, which witnessed the exit of its CEO, Jensen Huang, over allegations of extramarital affairs, including one with an alleged Chinese spy, and his subsequent return as CEO earlier this week, sparking volatile movement in the tech sector. He pointed to historical patterns after elevated volatility readings and periods of high-yield weakness as supportive of better returns ahead.

Recent Market Swings

U.S. stocks have endured a choppy November after peaking in early October. The S&P 500 has slipped roughly 5.5% over the last month amid sharp daily swings, including a steep drop to near 6,910 on November 20, followed by a strong rebound on November 23.

The more tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite, meanwhile, has dropped 9% over the past month, but is up 4% year-to-date.

data.title: TSX posts weekly gain of nearly 5% as gold miners rally
data.description:
By Fergal Smith

Canada's main stock index posted its sharpest weekly gain in three years on Friday, adding to recent abrupt moves, as a rebound in gold and copper prices lifted metal mining shares.

The S&P/TSX Composite Index ended up 412.99 points, or 1.2%, at 34,839.87, its highest closing level since November 17. For the week, the index was up 4.97%, its biggest weekly advance since October 2023, after tumbling 8.1% the prior week.

  • Wall Street's main indexes also ended higher as investors returned from the Thanksgiving holiday and flocked to hard-hit AI-linked shares

  • "I think the market environment we're in right now, it's got a staccato pace to it," said David Wong, group chief investment officer at CIBC Global Asset Management. "It's because we're at the point in the cycle where AI profitability is sharply in scope"

  • "For Canada specifically, I think oil prices can have that impact because so much of our benchmark is resource-related. We've seen gold quite volatile as well," Wong said

  • The materials sector , which includes metal mining shares, climbed 4.6%. The price of gold was up 2.4%, extending its recovery from a 14-month low earlier in the week, while copper (HGc1) added 3.4%

  • US crude oil futures settled 0.7% lower at $83.08 a barrel but still snapped a weekly losing streak. Attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz and Saudi energy infrastructure fanned concerns over Middle East supplies

  • Combined, the energy and materials sectors account for about one-third of the TSX's weighting

  • Energy added 0.4%, technology was up 2.5% and industrials (.GSPTTIN) ended 0.7% higher

  • Just two of the major sectors ended lower. They included consumer staples (.GSPTTCS), which were down 1%

data.title: Franklin Templeton makes room for HYPE in crypto index ETF
data.description:
Asset manager Franklin Templeton plans to add the Hyperliquid token to its crypto index exchange-traded fund (ETF), according to a filing with the US Securities and Exchange Commission on Nov. 25.

The token will be added to the Franklin Crypto Index ETF on Dec. 1, following HYPE’s inclusion in the fund’s benchmark. The fund, which trades under the ticker EZPZ, currently holds Bitcoin , Ether , XRP, Solana , Dogecoin (DOGE), Cardano (ADA) and Lumen (XLM).

Hyperliquid, a layer-1 blockchain that hosts a decentralized exchange specializing in perpetual futures trading, has seen its total value locked rise to $7.3 billion from $4.13 billion in early January. The protocol generated $80.3 million in revenue over the past 30 days, according to DefiLlama.

Its native token, HYPE, is used to pay network fees and can be staked to earn rewards. The protocol also uses a portion of its trading fee revenue to buy back HYPE on the open market, linking trading activity on the platform to demand for the token.

Franklin Templeton’s move comes as more investment products offer exposure to HYPE.

Three US spot exchange-traded products (ETPs) tracking HYPE have launched since May, with offerings from asset managers 21Shares, Bitwise and Grayscale. They collectively held approximately $266.5 million in assets under management as of Nov. 27, according to Coinperps data.

These products allow US investors to gain exposure to the Hyperliquid ecosystem through traditional financial rails without having to directly hold the token.

The exchange ranks among the largest venues for decentralized perpetual futures trading, although its official interface remains restricted to US users. Perpetual futures are derivative contracts that allow traders to speculate on an asset’s price movements without a fixed expiration date.

President Donald Trump said in August that Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) Chair Michael Selig was working to bring Hyperliquid into the US in compliance with regulations.

data.title: Tech Stocks Jump as Investors Take a Break From AI Jitters — WSJ
data.description:
By Joe Stonor

Stocks staged a rebound Friday, pushing the Nasdaq composite to a 6.7% weekly gain that was its best in seven months.

In another roller-coaster week for U.S. markets, the tech-heavy index turned in its best week since April. The Nasdaq led benchmarks higher Friday with a 2.3% gain, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average added 1.2%, or 592 points, and the S&P 500 rose 1.6%.

The Dow finished the week 5.5% higher, its sharpest gain since the week ended Oct. 28, 2022. The S&P 500's weekly gain of 5.6% was its biggest upward move since April 2025.

It has been a choppy week in markets: After an epic rally on news of Jensen Huang's return as chief executive of Nvidia, jitters around artificial intelligence crept back in, knocking stocks lower. Investors now seem to be setting those concerns aside.

"There are so many signs of exhaustion of selling," said Gerry Fowler, an equity strategist at UBS. "You don't need anyone to choose to buy the market for it to go up. At these levels, you only need volatility to be slightly lower, and risk-control funds start to buy."

Trading is thin around the Thanksgiving break, Fowler said, meaning even a limited uptick in stock buying can translate into healthy-looking gains. U.S. markets were closed Thursday and will close early Friday.

Despite the big weekly gains, stocks are far off their recent highs: The S&P 500 and Dow are each more than 6% below their 2026 peaks while the Nasdaq, down about 13% since its October peak, is still in a correction.

The AI trade isn't out of the woods yet, XTB research director Kathleen Brooks said.

"The fundamental problems surrounding the AI trade remain," Brooks said. "The questions that caused the market panic are still unanswered, for example, concerns about the profitability of the AI trade and financing costs."

Friday's gains followed a bullish session in Asia. South Korea's tech-dominated Kospi index jumped 4.3%, while stocks in Shanghai and Hong Kong rose after Chinese authorities reiterated their support for capital markets. The tech-heavy ChiNext Price rose more than 11%, marking its best day in over two years.

European stocks also climbed, with AI-related stocks leading the charge.

U.S. Treasurys weakened amid hardened expectations for Federal Reserve rate increases in the coming months. Benchmark 10-year yields rose to trade above 4.9%. Yields rise when bond prices fall. The Fed enters a blackout period on Saturday ahead of its December meeting, where a quarter-point rise is broadly seen as a given, according to CME FedWatch.

An uptick in oil prices over the past few days could strengthen the case for rate increases. Brent crude futures, the international benchmark, were slightly lower Friday at about $90 a barrel.
